name: Saar Basin Territory
native: Territoire du Bassin de la Sarre
alt: Saar under the League of Nations

predecessors.name: Weimar Republic
predecessors.text: the Saar Basin: 'the portions of the Prussian Rhenish Trier Region and the Bavarian district of the Palatinate' set out in Article 48 of the Treaty of Versailles; the territory 'closely corresponds…

successors.name: Nazi Germany
successors.text: 'On 1 March, Germany re-integrated the region into the German Reich'

ledger.x: 10 January 1920: the Saar Basin Territory is created under a League of Nations Governing Commission.
1 March 1935: the Saar returns to Germany.
1 March 1935: the Saar Basin Territory ceases.

certainty.note: The frontier is the one laid down in Articles 45-50 of the Treaty of Versailles (Article 48 sets out the boundary); it did not move in fifteen years.
